If you want verifiable details, you can do one of the following and I’ll help:

- Tell me which specific answer or claim you mean (paste it here). I’ll say what I based that claim on (what assumptions vs. what’s standard knowledge) and list what exact source(s) would be needed to verify it.
- Allow or ask me to search the web (I can run a live check if browsing is available) and I’ll return exact office, date, and quotation with citations.
- Provide the document or text you want me to inspect and I’ll extract the office, date, and quotation from it.

If you prefer to search yourself, tell me the claim and I’ll suggest precise search queries and likely authoritative sources to check. Which option do you want?
